title: Common Data Types for Insurance Application
description: Standardized data types used across various insurance application schemas.

currency.description: A monetary value, typically with 2 decimal places.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'US' for United States, 'IN' for India.

phone.description: E.164 international format, ensuring all non-numeric characters except the leading '+' are removed.
